A '''redstone golem''' is a {{MCD|powerful}} {{MCD|golem}} that can be found within the various {{MCD|mission}}s of {{MCD}}. A non-powerful redstone golem can rarely be summoned by the {{MCD|Arch-Illager}} atop the {{MCD|Obsidian Pinnacle}}.

== Lore ==
{{SpoilerWarning|section|{{MCD}}}}
Redstone golems were the first known mobs created by the {{MCD|Orb of Dominance}}, even before {{MCD|Archie}} took hold of the Orb. There were six unactivated redstone golems already within the cave where the Orb resided. A redstone golem is also seen attacking {{MCD|iron golem}}s within the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mJczpIdONjs intro cinematic]. In the [[Minecraft Dungeons:The Rise of the Arch-Illager|prequel]] novel, the golems were made by filling a mold made of [[diamonds]] with [[redstone]], that would melt from the lava surrounding the mold, before being animated by the Orb.

== Behavior ==
Redstone golems have five behaviors.

=== Run ===
Redstone golems run toward their target, stomping their feet loudly. Their speed almost matches that of the hero if they are not using any speed buffs.

=== Swipe attack ===
Redstone golems swing one of their arms across to attack, dealing heavy damage and high knockback to any hero or summon within range every 1.3 seconds.

=== Karate Chop ===
Exclusive to the Arcade Edition of the game, Redstone Golems can karate chop heroes standing in front of them.

=== Charge up electric transfer attack ===
Periodically, the redstone golem hunches over and digs its arms into the ground while overloading the redstone in its body. This causes fourteen mines to appear in random areas of the ground around it over a small period. Touching the mines causes them to explode, dealing high damage in a small area. Pets are still capable of triggering the mines despite the fact that they are never targets of the golem. While performing this attack, the golem is immobile.

=== Novelty ===
Redstone golems rarely beat their chests repeatedly before roaring when being idle. This is usually unseen due to the golem's high targeting range.

== Health ==
Redstone golems have 5,000 HP in the code, the most HP of any miniboss. The unbreakable one has 10,000 HP in the code. On Default I, all mobs have 9.6% health and 12% damage of what is set in the code.

== Trivia ==
* On the loading screen for [[Dungeons:Obsidian Pinnacle|Obsidian Pinnacle]], a redstone golem can be seen in the final part of its "novelty animation".
* Attacking a redstone golem's legs after electric transfer attack causes it to stop moving. This glitch disappears when the hero moves far enough away to avoid being hit by a stationary golem.
